title: pretty FAUN|Simple Plus Size Lace Evening Dress with Half Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
When the occasion calls for a chic and elegant look, go in for this flowing see-through lace plus size formal evening dress. The sophistication of this evening dress for curve is amplified because of its lace bodice and sleeves. The plus size lace evening dress is uniquely complemented with a figure-flattering wide ribbon waistband that accentuates the waistline. The romantically designed V-shaped back guarantees a look that will make heads turn upon your arrival at any party, wedding or even your prom. Learn more about how to choose plus size formal dresses and find right styles for your curvy body, Please read "Ultimate Guide to Plus Size Dresses"!


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is Concealed Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Padded Enough For No Bra Option, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester   
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.
